evidence.quote: Zotero plugin providing MCP-based academic and web resource search across multiple platforms with direct Zotero integration

checkNote: The cited manifest description supports neither answer. Every key pref in the pack defaults to empty ('pref("...web.tavily.apiKey", "")'), and the pack doesn't say which sources work keyless, so the API key answer stays unknown. The plugin has an xAI provider with an editable baseUrl ('web.xai.baseUrl', default "https://api.x.ai/v1") and an MCP server on 127.0.0.1 for external AI clients. Whether any local model can be used is not settled, so local is unknown rather than no.
